ops.title: Watch upstream hermes-agent PRs #45717/#45317; retire or swap vendored misroute patch on merge
ops.description: Dedup check 2026-07-07: do NOT file an upstream issue — the iMessage DM-to-group misroute is already tracked by issues #34372/#24157/#30708 (open) and #33327 (closed as dup of PR #45317). Two competing OPEN fix PRs: #45717 (byte-identical to our pkgs/patches/hermes-agent/pr-45717.diff) and #45317 (broader consolidation: same dedup/misroute fixes plus 127.0.0.1->localhost IPv6 coercion, [auth-key] group payload detection, webhook port conflicts — referenced as the consolidation target when #33327 closed). When bumping the hermes-agent flake input, check both PRs: if #45717 merged, drop our patch; if #45317 merged, swap our patch for its version (it covers more); if neither, keep vendoring.

ops.text: on a hermes-agent bump past either PR's merge, pkgs/patches/hermes-agent/pr-45717.diff is removed or replaced accordingly and the hermes image builds
